## Logos

Paths are relative to the workspace root. Use the **light** mark on light grounds
and the **dark** (inverted) mark on dark grounds. Never recolor, stretch, or
outline the SVG.

## Consume in HTML documents

Standalone documents embed the token sheet; they do not link it.
`doc.py new --brand officekit` (or the workspace default) inlines
`brands/officekit/tokens.css` and the marks. Use semantic variables
(`--color-primary`, `--font-sans`, `--font-heading`) instead of
hardcoded hex or font names.

## Consume in Slidev

Import the same stylesheet from the deck (for example in `style.css`):

```css
@import "../../brands/officekit/tokens.css";
```

`tokens.css` aliases `--slidev-theme-primary`, `--slidev-theme-background`,
`--slidev-font-sans`, and `--slidev-font-mono` so Slidev chrome follows the brand.

## Consume in HyperFrames

Copy this brand into the project's local `brand/` snapshot, then read
`brand/frame.md`. Frontmatter hex values and font families are normative.
Bind them onto the composition root; do not invent a second accent or substitute fonts.
